main.description: Public paginated discovery listing of indexed Certified profiles. Authentication is not required. This endpoint accepts pagination parameters only; use getProfiles for actor-specific batch lookup and searchProfiles for profile-text search. The handler applies limit=25 and sortDirection=desc when omitted; limit is 1..100. Results sort by a valid zoned createdAt, otherwise indexedAt (or stored row creation time when indexedAt is absent), then URI, both in the requested direction. The opaque cursor is direction-bound and provides no snapshot guarantee; keep other parameters unchanged between pages. Unknown parameters and repeated scalar keys are rejected.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction; handler default is desc.

cursor.description: Opaque versioned keyset cursor bound to sortDirection.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A parameter is invalid, repeated where scalar, or unknown.

errors.name: ProfileQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed profiles could not be queried.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when pagination is complete.
